turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Melissa Goh speaking. How can I help you today? If you're calling between appointments, we can keep the conversation focused.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Melissa, Adrian Tan here. Yes, I'm between work meetings, so telephone is much easier today. Let me give you my particulars first. [[EV_010]] [[EV_011]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. I'll bring up your profile. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would a callback be more convenient?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm in my office with the door closed, so now is fine. The warehouse team will only come looking for me later. [[EV_012]] [[EV_015]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: All right, we can keep to the scheduled discussion. [[EV_006]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My calendar has been quite packed lately. In a family business, even when someone else handles the daily work, people still come to you with questions.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a busy morning. [[EV_016]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_013]] [[EV_014]] I have my notes beside me, so I won't need to leave the room to look for anything.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll cover the relevant points now. [[EV_004]] [[EV_005]] [[EV_001]] [[EV_002]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_003]] Please carry on. I've asked my staff to leave me undisturbed while we're on the telephone.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. There's no need to come down to the branch just for our telephone appointment. For future calls, would mornings or afternoons generally fit your workday better?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Afternoons are usually better, once the warehouse briefing is over. Anyway, let me finish what I called about. [[EV_019]] [[EV_018]] [[EV_017]] [[EV_020]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll keep any follow-up communication on your usual contact channel. Is there anything else you need to tell me before we finish the call?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Actually, there is something I should mention now rather than leave it out. [[EV_009]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. I need to pause here and refer this for internal review. I cannot complete the processing during this call. I'll arrange for the appropriate team to follow up with you.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay. I'm going into another meeting shortly, so if someone calls and I don't answer, please leave a message asking me to return the call. Don't put anything detailed in the message.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep the voicemail limited to a callback request. Please use the bank's usual contact number when returning it. I'll also note your preference for telephone appointments rather than a branch visit.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's fine, Melissa. Getting away from the office is difficult these days, so a call suits me better. I need to join my meeting now. Thanks for your time, goodbye.
